testCaseSummary: Creates a manual expense with a receipt, edits its description and changes Gross to a random amount, checks Net is recalculated from the VAT rate, then verifies the list and the reopened expense show the edited values.
grossRoundingDefectTitle: Saving recalculates Gross from Net and rounds a half-penny VAT amount down, changing the Gross the user typed (313.65 at T5 saved as 313.64)
